**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is `dep-4471`, the gateway connection-per-request config. It drains the 20 connection pool. Every 503 pairs with `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`.

Window runs 02:14:18.972Z to 03:59:27.974Z, still open. 530 of 636 requests failed. The only 200s were `/health`.

Roll back `dep-4471`. The worker slowdown is logged as separate.
